provenance.mechanism: Probe four preferred byte vectors for ASCII; remember successful range and suppress overlapping failed probes. On ARM64, Clang if-converts current-block fallback, yielding two reductions per four-block probe, plus scalar branches and state spills.
provenance.decision: Rejected at pilot: clear ASCII and sparse-Unicode regressions. No confirmatory run performed. No grouped production change retained.

from pathlib import Path
import json,math,statistics,sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); protocol=json.loads((root/'protocol.json').read_text()); n=protocol['forks_per_payload'];t={3:4.3026527299,25:2.0638985616}[n]
rows=[]
for payload in ('ascii','unicode','sparseUnicode'):
 forks=[json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(root.glob(payload+'-??.json'))]
 assert len(forks)==n,(payload,len(forks))
 data=[f['payloads'][0] for f in forks]; first=data[0]
 assert all(d['payload']==payload and d['digest']==first['digest'] and len(d['fused']['samples'])==protocol['samples_per_fork'] for d in data)
 paired=[statistics.median(math.log(a/b) for a,b in zip(d['fused']['samples'],d['baseline']['samples'])) for d in data]
 center=statistics.mean(paired); delta=t*statistics.stdev(paired)/math.sqrt(n)
 low,high=math.exp(center-delta),math.exp(center+delta)
 verdict='improved' if low>1/.99 else 'regressed' if high<1/1.01 else 'unchanged' if low>=1/1.01 and high<=1/.99 else 'inconclusive'
 control=[d['lunajson']['median'] for d in data]
 rows.append({'payload':payload,'bytes':first['bytes'],'digest':first['digest'],'forks':n,'candidate_MBps':statistics.median(d['fused']['median'] for d in data),'baseline_MBps':statistics.median(d['baseline']['median'] for d in data),'throughput_ratio':math.exp(center),'ratio_CI95':[low,high],'duration_change_percent':100*(1/math.exp(center)-1),'verdict':verdict,'control_MBps':statistics.median(control),'control_min_max':[min(control),max(control)],'control_cv_percent':100*statistics.stdev(control)/statistics.mean(control),'fork_paired_log_ratios':paired})
report={'payloads':rows,'retention_pass':rows[0]['ratio_CI95'][0]>1/.99 and all(row['ratio_CI95'][0]>1/1.01 for row in rows[1:])}
(root/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

index bce7403c..4b4cb2fa 100644
--- a/src/nupp/codec/json/internal/decoder/fused.nupp
+++ b/src/nupp/codec/json/internal/decoder/fused.nupp
@@ -159,6 +159,8 @@ local function decodeFused<const Variant: integer>(
     local seeded = false
 
     local previousNonAscii = false
+    local asciiThrough: uint32 = 0
+    local asciiProbeAfter: uint32 = 0
     local one: uint64 = 1
 
     -- Set when the lookup has seen a malformed pair. The scan then finishes a
@@ -186,7 +188,31 @@ local function decodeFused<const Variant: integer>(
                 -- reach of it. A vector of ASCII after a vector of ASCII
                 -- cannot be malformed, and one after a non-ASCII vector is
                 -- classified so the pairs straddling the boundary are seen.
-                local currentNonAscii = (block >= 128):any()
+                local currentNonAscii = false
+                if scanCursor >= asciiThrough then
+                    if not previousNonAscii
+                        and scanCursor >= asciiProbeAfter
+                        and scanCursor + species.lanes * 4 <= sourceCount
+                    then
+                        -- One high-bit test can cover four ASCII blocks. The
+                        -- normal scan still drains each block's events in
+                        -- order, so lookahead never reports an error early.
+                        local second = species:load(bytes, scanCursor + species.lanes + 1)
+                        local third = species:load(bytes, scanCursor + species.lanes * 2 + 1)
+                        local fourth = species:load(bytes, scanCursor + species.lanes * 3 + 1)
+                        asciiProbeAfter = scanCursor + species.lanes * 4
+                        if not ((block | second | third | fourth) >= 128):any() then
+                            asciiThrough = asciiProbeAfter
+                        else
+                            -- A failed group says nothing about this block.
+                            -- Do not retry an overlapping group while draining
+                            -- these four blocks, even when some are ASCII.
+                            currentNonAscii = (block >= 128):any()
+                        end
+                    else
+                        currentNonAscii = (block >= 128):any()
+                    end
+                end
                 if currentNonAscii or previousNonAscii then
                     -- The vector before this one, read again rather than
                     -- carried: a vector cannot cross an iteration of this
diff --git a/tests/jsonfuseddifferentialtest.lua b/tests/jsonfuseddifferentialtest.lua
index 5e97e4a2..183d2309 100644
--- a/tests/jsonfuseddifferentialtest.lua
+++ b/tests/jsonfuseddifferentialtest.lua
@@ -407,4 +407,37 @@ function M.decodingIsUnchangedByTheSourceLength()
     end
 end
 
+
+-- Lookahead may include later Unicode or a later error, but only the current
+-- block can advance the scan or select its first error. Sweep group boundaries
+-- and transitions back to long ASCII runs rather than only dense Unicode.
+function M.groupedAsciiLookaheadPreservesTransitionsTailsAndFirstErrors()
+    local euro, smile = "\226\130\172", "\240\159\152\128"
+    for pad = 0, 260 do
+        for _, gap in ipairs({0, 15, 16, 31, 32, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129}) do
+            local text = '"' .. string.rep("a", pad) .. euro .. string.rep("b", gap) .. smile .. string.rep("c", pad % 67) .. '"'
+            local mine, message = decodedBy(fused, text)
+            local theirs, other = decodedBy(lunajson, text)
+            assert(message == nil and other == nil, "mixed Unicode refused at " .. pad .. ":" .. gap .. ": " .. tostring(message))
+            assert(mine == theirs, "mixed Unicode changed at " .. pad .. ":" .. gap)
+        end
+        for _, bad in ipairs(BAD_UTF8) do
+            for _, suffix in ipairs({"", string.rep("z", 65)}) do
+                local text = '"' .. string.rep("a", pad) .. bad .. suffix .. '"'
+                local code, position = referenceScan(text)
+                assert(code == INVALID_UTF8, "reference missed grouped malformed UTF-8")
+                local _, message = decodedBy(fused, text)
+                local reported = message and tonumber(message:match("at byte (%d+)"))
+                assert(reported == position, "grouped malformed UTF-8 at " .. pad .. ": " .. tostring(reported) .. " vs " .. position)
+            end
+        end
+        -- A control error before the lookahead's malformed Unicode stays first.
+        local text = '"' .. string.rep("a", pad) .. "\001" .. string.rep("b", 65) .. "\255\""
+        local code, position = referenceScan(text)
+        assert(code == INVALID_CONTROL)
+        local _, message = decodedBy(fused, text)
+        assert(message and tonumber(message:match("at byte (%d+)")) == position, "lookahead displaced earlier control error")
+    end
+end
+
 return M
